# Subject-alternative-name vectors, EC P-256, all ecdsa-with-SHA256, validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, keys not stored.
#   root_cert (serial 1, self-signed, CA:TRUE) issues both leaves; each has EKU serverAuth+clientAuth and keyUsage digitalSignature.
#   san_leaf_cert (serial 2) carries subjectAltName DNS:localhost, DNS:alt.example.test, IP:192.0.2.17, IP:2001:db8::1, email:user@example.test and
#     URI:spiffe://example.test/service, in that order.
#   plain_leaf_cert (serial 3) carries no subjectAltName extension.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (each certificate)
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "/CN=<name>" -out X.csr    (names: TlsLib Names Root, TlsLib Names Leaf, TlsLib Names Plain Leaf)
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -selfsign -in root.csr -keyfile root.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile ca.ext -notext -out root.pem
#   openssl ca -batch -config ca.cnf -in X.csr -cert root.pem -keyfile root.key -startdate NB -enddate NA -extfile X.ext -notext -out X.pem
#     ca.cnf: [ca] default_ca=c / [c] database=index.txt new_certs_dir=. serial=serial.txt default_md=sha256 policy=p unique_subject=no / [p] commonName=supplied
#     ca.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:true / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#     san.ext / plain.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid,
#       plus subjectAltName=<the list above> for san.ext only
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem X.pem: both leaves verify
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
san_leaf_
plain_leaf_
